result.blocking_gap: A new, intermittent test flake was introduced by this branch's own config/test.exs change (lua_wallclock_timeout_ms: 200 applied globally to the default execute_with_manifest/2 arity), which under realistic 8-way parallel `mix test` load spuriously times out an unrelated pre-existing test (the AC6 INV-LSA-2 manifest-mismatch test in the same file) roughly 1 run in 2 observed here. This is distinct from and additional to the pre-existing, unrelated ISS-0340 ContextTest race -- it lives inside this branch's own diff (config/test.exs + executor_test.exs's shared file) and was not caught by TEST-RUNNER's single Step-4 run. AC-8 requires mix test to pass with real output quoted; a test suite that intermittently fails on an unrelated assertion because of this branch's chosen test-env timeout value does not satisfy that reliably. Recommended fix (small, does not require redesign): either raise config/test.exs's lua_wallclock_timeout_ms to a value with enough headroom for non-timeout-path tests running under full-suite parallel load (e.g. 1000-2000ms -- all of REQ-155's own timing-sensitive tests already pass an explicit :timeout_ms via the /3 arity and are unaffected by this default), or give the AC6 mismatch test (and any other default-arity call in the suite) its own generous explicit timeout so it stops depending on the tight global default.
result.next_action: Route back to ELIXIR-DEV for a targeted fix to config/test.exs's lua_wallclock_timeout_ms default (or the affected test's arity/timeout), then back through TEST-RUNNER and this gate before DOC-UPDATER.
